title: Stonewalling
question: You have two sentences to tell a colleague what stonewalling is and what it does to the other person.

paragraphs.text: Stonewalling means withdrawing from a conversation.
You go quiet, change the subject or leave the room.
paragraphs.note: This gives examples. The first sentence already says what stonewalling is.

paragraphs.text: It usually happens when you feel overwhelmed.
paragraphs.note: This says when stonewalling happens. Your two sentences cover what it is and what it does to the other person.

paragraphs.text: The other person can't see that.
paragraphs.note: This says what the other person can't see. The last sentence says what stonewalling does to them.

paragraphs.text: They see you withdraw and feel ignored or rejected.
